blocks.content: A contact point is where Grafana sends notifications when the alert fires. You created one earlier in this course — now select it.
To select a contact point, complete the following steps:

In the alert GUI, scroll to **Section 5: Configure notifications**.

Click the **Contact point** dropdown and select the contact point you created earlier (for example, **email-alerts**).
Skip **Muting, grouping and timings (optional)** for now.
Your alert rule now has a contact point configured. When the alert fires, Grafana sends a notification to this destination.
